headline: Expenditures for a compressor, training grounds prop, and air supply unit, plus special budget meeting dates and the 2027 firefighter new hire list.
summary: The meeting will cover spending on a compressor, a training grounds prop, and an air supply unit. It also includes special budget meeting dates, a 2027 firefighter new hire list, and personnel matters.
